description.narrative: Clean teknologin facilitatörn kommer att hjälpa svenska och indiska partners för att utveckla kontakter och etablera nätverk möjligheter med syfte att sprida miljöanpassad teknik inom massa-och pappers-sektor och eventuellt i andra industrisektorer.

The Clean technology facilitator will assist Swedish and Indian partners to develop contacts and will establish networking possibilities with the aim of spreading environmentally friendly technology in the pulp and paper sector and possibly in other industrial sectors.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2014Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: - Increased understanding among Indian pulp and paper companies of the need for cleaner production technologies in the sector. - Increased knowledge about Swedish technologies that can contribute to the development of cleaner production within the pulp and paper industry. - increased knowledge and understanding of the Indian market, including development of business models for Swedish companies to enter the Indian pulp and paper market. - Five deals between Swedish and Indian companies have been closed and additional discussions are ongoing. - Indian and Swedish project partners see opportunities for further cooperation.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
